title: Tasty Jam Dance Party
description: A colorful 13-panel comic strip featuring SpongeBob SquarePants characters and original black female characters dancing and partying underwater in Bikini Bottom. The panels show a sequence from leaving work to a final dance scene with Squidward watching through binoculars, culminating in a large 'Tasty Jam' title with jellyfish.
prompt: A vibrant 13-panel comic page in the style of SpongeBob SquarePants featuring a group of dancing characters including original black women with curly hair and purple outfits, alongside Squidward, Patrick, and other sea creatures. Panels show leaving work, heading home to a pineapple house, party preparations, dancing, Squidward spying with binoculars from his window looking annoyed, and a final group dance scene with jellyfish. Bright blue underwater background, musical notes, bold title TASTY JAM in large pink and yellow letters at the bottom right, fun cartoon style with clear panel borders and speech bubbles.
